title: Batch Rebuild Rate Card for Factory Production Orders
content:
Three or more units remade on one remake are charged at 90 percent, two at 95 percent. For Factory Production Orders, a batch rebuild rate applies to the charge for a customer specification remake by the units remade:

| Units remade on the remake | Rate applied to the charge base |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 90 percent |
| 2 | 95 percent |
| 1 | in full |

The rate multiplies the charge base itself, and the charge is rounded to the cent once, at the end. The units remade are those on the remake record with cause customer specification error.

## Hypothetical examples (Custom Color Build, class remake charge 229.00 per unit, base equal to the class charge times the units)

| Units remade | Base | Rate | Amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 229.00 | in full | 229.00 |
| 2 | 458.00 | 95 percent | 435.10 |
| 3 | 687.00 | 90 percent | 618.30 |
| 5 | 1,145.00 | 90 percent | 1,030.50 |
